description: Model assignment per Gentle-AI ODD subagent (build-time layer). Not product runtime code. All providers zero-cost per project architecture section 4.2. Model names resolve against the gentle-ai.model-variants plugin cache.
fallback_strategy: On provider unavailability or rate limit, switch to the declared fallback_model for that subagent. Never fall back to a paid provider.

gentle-orchestrator.role: Orchestrates the ODD workflow: authorizes, explores, classifies task size, delegates workers/verifiers, verifies outcomes, updates feature docs.

gentle-ai-explore.role: Read-only code exploration and mapping. Returns bounded handoffs (~2k tokens) with path:line evidence; never writes.

gentle-ai-worker.role: Implementation writer. Executes bounded units with declared allowed edit surfaces, writes code+tests+docs together.

gentle-ai-verify.role: Independent technical verification of high-risk changes (named via --escalate-item). Runs focused probes against specs, not full sweeps.
